name: Inshi Reizoku ~Kage ni Hisonda Aiyoku to Shihai~
original_name: 淫姉隷属 ～影に潜んだ愛欲と支配～
source:
"It wasn't over yet..."
About a month ago, a man developed a one-sided crush on me.

This man, whom I'd never even met, asked me out through my blog.
I declined, stating, "I have a boyfriend."

The man responded, "If you really have a boyfriend, then go on a date with him."
To convince him, I asked my younger brother to play the role of my lover.
While I was on a date with my brother as instructed, he commented during the date:
"If he's your real lover, you can at least kiss him, right?"

I shuddered. It was as if my time with my brother was being monitored in real time.

Not knowing what to do, I... kissed him.
Since then, I haven't heard any more comments from him.

I thought he'd given up on me, but then...
"He" showed up again...
translation:
“还没有结束……”

大约一个月前，有个男人单方面喜欢上了我。

这个我从未见过的男人，通过我的博客向我告白。
我以“我有男朋友”为由拒绝了他。

男人回答：“如果你真的有男朋友，那就和他去约会。”
为了说服他，我拜托弟弟假扮我的恋人。
约会时，我按他的要求和弟弟在一起；期间，他发来评论：

“如果他是真正的恋人，至少可以接吻吧？”

我打了个寒颤。那感觉就像有人在实时监视我和弟弟相处的过程。

我不知所措……吻了弟弟。
从那以后，我再也没有听到他的评论。

我以为他已经放弃了我，可是……
“他”再次出现了……
